ItemStackRequest.verification_scope: Forged ItemStackRequest packets built to this layout were accepted by a self-hosted BDS 1.26.60.6 across the full manual craft flow (place, craft_recipe, results_deprecated, consume, take) for planks, stick, crafting table, wooden/stone pickaxe and oak boat (2026-11-16). The packet +0x10 connection pointer must be borrowed from a real outgoing packet of the same session; without it the send path drops the packet silently.
